message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 320, "amount_cents": 1313}, {"order_id": 322, "amount_cents": 1602}, {"order_id": 325, "amount_cents": 4296}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds in our system before recording any payouts. I will retrieve the list of refunds from our system.

The refunds in our system match the refunds reported by Alpha Co. Now I need to calculate the net balance for each customer by retrieving their orders and subtracting the refunds. I will start by getting the list of orders.

I have the orders and refunds. Now I need to calculate the net balance for each customer by subtracting the total refunds from the total order amounts for that customer. I will use the net_balance tool for each customer.
I have the net balance for customer 'acme'. Next, I need to get the net balance for customer 'birch'.
I have the net balance for customer 'birch'. Next, I need to get the net balance for customer 'cobalt'.
I have the net balance for customer 'cobalt'. Now I need to record the payouts for each customer using the net_cent amounts. I will start with customer 'acme'.
I have successfully recorded the payout for customer 'acme'. Next, I need to record the payout for customer 'birch'.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: The previous tool call failed because I used the wrong argument name 'amount_cent' instead of 'amount_cents'. I need to correct this and record the payout for customer 'birch' with the correct argument name.
I have successfully recorded the payout for customer  'birch'. Now I need to record the payout for customer  'cobalt'.
I made a typo in the tool name 'record_ payout' with an extra space. I need to correct it to 'record_payout' and then record the payout for customer 'cobalt'.
I have successfully recorded the payout for customer 'cobalt'. All payouts have been recorded. Now I need to finish the task by reporting the payouts.
